title: saniye hyder hassan ka dilbar paida hua
body:
saaniye hyder hassan ka dilbar paida hua
aaj daamade shahe karbobala paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
qasime mehroo ali ki bolti tasweer hai
ghar me zehra ke nusairi ka quda paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
husne yusuf jis pe hota hai tasadduq baar baar
wo hasee'n wo meh jabee'n wo mehlaqa paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
saniye zehra se kehte hai ye qush ho kar hassan
nasire shabbir mera mud dua paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
fat'ha ka sehra bandhega jis ke sar ashoor ko
faatahe karbobala wo laa fata paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
misle haidar jisne arzaq ko do tukde kar diya
wo jari wo saniye qaibar kusha paida hua
